# QuantumDB

> QuantumDB is the curated database of the three main academic conferences in quantum information science: QIP (Quantum Information Processing, {{ qip_years }}), QCrypt (Conference on Quantum Cryptography, {{ qcrypt_years }}) and TQC (Theory of Quantum Computation, Communication and Cryptography, {{ tqc_years }}). It is maintained by the International Association for Quantum Information (IAQI), which also hosts the archived conference websites (qip.iaqi.org, qcrypt.iaqi.org, tqc.iaqi.org). The data is free to use under CC0 1.0.

It currently holds {{ conference_count }} conference instances, {{ talk_count }} talks, {{ poster_count }} posters, {{ author_count }} authors and {{ committee_count }} committee roles (programme, steering and organizing committees). Each conference also lists the figures announced at its business meeting (registrations, submissions, acceptance rates) when they are known. Data collection is ongoing: when something is missing, it usually just hasn't been entered yet.

## Recommended: bulk exports (one request, no pagination, author names inline)

- [Index of all conferences]({{ base }}/api/v1/export/all.json): every conference with its dates, location, counts and the URLs of its exports
- [One conference, complete]({{ base }}/api/v1/export/conferences/qip-2015): committees, talks and posters with ordered authors (name, slug, ORCID, affiliation, presenter flag), abstracts, arXiv ids, video/slide links and business-meeting figures. Replace `qip-2015` with any `<venue>-<year>` (venues: `qip`, `qcrypt`, `tqc`)
- Per-conference CSVs: `{{ base }}/api/v1/export/conferences/<slug>/talks.csv`, `.../posters.csv` and `.../committees.csv`. They use the same columns as the CSV files in the GitHub repository; lists inside a cell are separated by `;`
- [Full dataset]({{ base }}/api/v1/export/all-full.json): every conference, nested, in one file (about 19 MB, or 4 MB gzip-compressed)
- [All authors]({{ base }}/api/v1/export/authors.json): permanent slugs, ORCID and Google Scholar ids, activity summary

## REST API

- [OpenAPI specification]({{ base }}/api/v1/openapi.json) and [Swagger UI]({{ base }}/api/v1/swagger-ui/)
- Read endpoints are public: `/api/v1/conferences`, `/api/v1/authors`, `/api/v1/publications?conference=QIP2015&search=...`, `/api/v1/committees?conference=QIP2015`, `/api/v1/authorships`, `/api/v1/stats/conferences`
- Rate limit: 10 requests per second per IP (bursts up to 100). For whole conferences, use the exports above

## Web pages

- [Conferences]({{ base }}/conferences), e.g. {{ base }}/conferences/qip-2015
- [Authors]({{ base }}/authors), e.g. {{ base }}/authors/<slug>
- [Publication search]({{ base }}/publications), full-text over titles, abstracts and author names
- [Sitemap]({{ base }}/sitemap.xml)

## Source data

- [GitHub repository]({{ source_repo }}): the source-of-truth CSVs live in `data/conferences/<venue>_<year>/` (`committees.csv`, `talks.csv`, `posters.csv`, `business_meeting.csv`; TQC uses `proceedings.csv` and `workshop.csv`). Schemas are in `data/README.md` and provenance in `data/SOURCES.md`. The live exports above are generated from the database and include identifiers (author slugs, ORCIDs) that the CSVs lack
